say:2:1410310201:1.source_cn: 啧……赶在我心情最差的时候撞见了<style=high...

say:3:1410310202:1.text: Hey, pointy ears! If it weren't for us surface folk building your fancy houses, you'd still be snoozing in mushroom patches!
say:3:1410310202:1.source_cn: 不懂礼貌的尖耳朵！要是没有我们这些地表人给你建房子，你...

say:4:1410310203:1.text: W-what... A mere toplander, rejected by magic, dares to insult me?!
say:4:1410310203:1.source_cn: 什、什么……区区一个被魔法厌嫌的地表弃民！竟敢对我语出狂言！

say:5:1410310204:1.text: Hah! What's magic worth if you can't lift a brick? I could blast you to bits before you finish a single incantation!
say:5:1410310204:1.source_cn: 哼，砖头都搬不动的废物，会魔法有什么用？在你把咒语念完...

say:7:1410310206:2.text: Sir, I'm on official duty. Do not interfere.
say:7:1410310206:2.source_cn: 这位大人，我在执行公务，别妨碍我。

say:8:1410310207:1.text: Such audacity! Let me see—ah, Captain Indris. Ah, <style="highlight">Prince Ravion's</style> ever-loyal pet.
say:8:1410310207:1.source_cn: 好大的口气！让我看看——呵，原来是<style=hig...

say:9:1410310208:1.text: I bet he's off drowning himself in wine. Why would he care about surface scum?
say:9:1410310208:1.source_cn: 沙利叶殿下怕是又在哪个宴会中饮酒作乐吧？他怎么会管地表...

say:10:1410310209:1.text: Matters concerning surface dwellers fall under <style="highlight">High Priestess Velara's</style> judgment. I am escorting them to her.
say:10:1410310209:1.source_cn: 地表人之事归由<style=highlight>奎茵冕...

say:11:1410310210:1.text: The High Priestess? You expect me to believe that? Since when have the <style="highlight">Three Exarchs</style> been so friendly?
say:11:1410310210:1.source_cn: 你说……带人面见奎茵冕下，别是借口吧！什么时候<sty...

say:12:1410310211:1.text: The Exarchs stand as one to protect Sal'thorin. Are you questioning that unity?
say:12:1410310211:1.source_cn: 三位长老精诚合作，共同拱卫萨洛克兰。你此话何意？

say:13:1410310212:1.text: Y-you... how dare you speak of High Priestess Velara so casually?! These outsiders have no right to stand before her!
say:13:1410310212:1.source_cn: 你、你——你把奎茵冕下当什么了？这些地表弃民也配面见大祭司？

say:14:1410310213:1.text: The law is clear. Matters concerning surface dwellers go to the High Priestess. Are you questioning the law?
say:14:1410310213:1.source_cn: 律法有言，地表事宜均交由奎茵冕下。你在质疑律法吗？

say:15:1410310214:1.text: You threaten me...? You commoner upstart! Don't think Ravion's favor makes you someone important!
say:15:1410310214:1.source_cn: 还敢威胁我……你这平民出身的卑贱者！别以为攀上了沙利叶...

say:16:1410310215:1.text: Listen! My Divine Dew has been stolen! The Queen's divine grace, taken from me!
say:16:1410310215:1.source_cn: 听着，我的灵露被偷了！有人抢走了女王赐予我的恩典！

say:17:1410310216:1.text: That is the real crisis! Not a pack of ill-omened wanderers! You—retrieve my Divine Dew at once!
say:17:1410310216:1.source_cn: 这才是大事，比几个不祥的地表人重要得多！你给我把恩典灵...

say:18:1410310217:1.text: Report to the Hall of Valor. My subordinates are on duty there. They will assist you.
say:18:1410310217:1.source_cn: 请移步荣光演武场，那里有我的属下正在执勤，他们会为你排...

say:19:1410310218:1.text: Insolence! You dare dismiss me?! I'll go to Ravion myself!
say:19:1410310218:1.source_cn: 混账东西！你是在打发我吗？我现在就过去找沙利叶殿下——

say:20:1410310219:1.text: Let's see how he handles a subordinate who's forgotten his place!
say:20:1410310219:1.source_cn: 看看他怎么处理你这个不知天高地厚的手下！

say:22:1410310221:1.text: Just you wait! When you're cast out, don't come crawling to me on your knees!
say:22:1410310221:1.source_cn: 等着瞧吧！你被逐出王城的时候可别来我面前下跪！
